How-to guide

Autofill a grid

Goal

Let the app fill the empty squares of your grid with words from your word lists, then keep or discard the result. Autofill is known to be imperfect: it can finish with entries that are not valid words, and some settings can stop without changing the grid. This page shows how to run it and read what comes back.

Prerequisites

  • A grid with black squares set and any words you want to keep already typed or placed (Set up the grid, Add theme words).
  • At least one word list ticked (Comprehensive Dictionary is ticked by default).

Steps

1. Open Autofill and review the options

Click Autofill in the left rail. The heading shows how many slots are still empty (a slot is one across or down entry; a slot with some letters but not all of them still counts as empty). Leave the options on their defaults unless you have a reason to change them:

Option What it does Default
Algorithm Repair (Recommended), Hybrid (Beam + Repair), Beam Search, Classic CSP Repair (Recommended)
Timeout How long a run may take: 1, 2, 5, 10 or 30 min 5 min
Min Score Minimum word score the fill may use, 0 to 100 in steps of 10 30
Adaptive mode unverified Lets the fill add black squares when it gets stuck; a Max adaptations slider (1 to 5) appears off, 3
Partial fill unverified Stops when stuck instead of backtracking hard off
Cleanup invalid words unverified After the fill, removes invalid words while keeping letters shared with valid crossing words off
Word Lists Which lists the fill may take words from; under Custom, a ticked list can be made the Priority theme list Comprehensive Dictionary

Use Repair (Recommended). The README warns that with Beam Search or Classic CSP a run can stop with the grid unchanged and no red cell (see Known Limitations).

unverified The descriptions of Adaptive mode, Partial fill and Cleanup invalid words come from the command-line tool's help text; their effects were not measured for this page.

Raising Min Score limits the fill to higher-scoring words but makes a complete fill harder; at the top of the scale a run on an open grid fills almost nothing.

2. Start the run

Click Start Autofill. The button is greyed out, with a hint under it, when no word list is ticked (Select at least one word list) or when there is nothing left to fill (Clear some cells to run autofill again). It is only shown while no result is open: after any outcome, click Reset before you start another run.

While it runs, the grid shows Editing is paused while autofill runs., and the panel shows a progress bar and Cancel. Wait for it to end, or click Cancel.

3. Read the result

The panel ends with one of these outcomes:

Message What happened What you can do
Successfully filled N/M slots! The fill completed with valid words; it is already in the grid Click Reset, then carry on
Filled N/M slots — K entries may be invalid (use Verify Words to check) (or some entries may need review in place of the count) Every square is filled, but some entries are not in the word list Keep fill, or Reset
Partial: N/M slots (P%) The run ended with squares still empty Keep partial fill (N/M slots), or Reset
Autofill could not fill around the highlighted letters. Letters already in the grid left no valid fill; those squares are marked red Keep partial fill, or Reset, then change the red letters
No word fits the highlighted letters. or The selected word lists have no words of length N. The run could not start usefully: a pattern fits no word in the chosen lists Change the highlighted letters or tick another list
Cancelled by user You clicked Cancel Reset; a Keep partial fill offer may appear if the run had made progress unverified
No solution found The run found no fill Reset unverified
Autofill failed, or the message the backend gave The run failed Reset unverified
Lost contact with the autofill run. The app lost its connection to the run Reset, then run again unverified
Autofill was paused outside the app. Someone paused the run from the command line; the app has no pause control Keep partial fill if offered, or Reset unverified

unverified Rows marked unverified are read from the app's code (src/hooks/useAutofillMachine.js) and were not reproduced for this page.

For the outcomes with a Keep button, the grid keeps showing the state from before the run until you click Keep fill (or Keep partial fill). Reset closes the result without taking the fill.

Autofill does not change letters you typed or theme words you locked.

4. Check what you kept

Click Verify words in the top bar. Entries that are not in the word list are flagged and listed in a message; see Check and clean a grid. Verify words checks only the shipped Comprehensive Dictionary, so words that come only from a custom list you ticked are flagged too, and Clean grid would blank them. To run again, click Reset, clear some squares if the grid is full, and click Start Autofill; results differ from run to run.

Final Result

The grid is filled (or partly filled) with your choice of result kept, and Verify words tells you which entries to look at again.
